rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip and matched to a single user. The agent reviewed orders and product variants. However, there are multiple policy violations and misses: 1) The agent executed the bicycle exchange without explicitly stating the exact change and obtaining the user’s confirmation beforehand, as required. 2) The bicycle exchange also altered type and color (road/green to mountain/red) beyond the user’s stated request (only a larger frame size) without confirmation. 3) For both exchanges, the agent used the Mastercard (credit_card_8105988) despite the user’s stated preference for Visa as the payment/refund method, and did not confirm the payment method. 4) For the camera, while the user gave a general go-ahead, the agent still did not present the exact variant and payment details for explicit confirmation before committing the write. 5) The jigsaw puzzle exchange failed because the agent first submitted a single-item exchange, changing the order status to exchange requested; this blocked a second exchange on the same order. The agent’s explanation (“only one exchange or return is allowed per delivered order”) did not accurately reflect the tool error (“non-delivered order cannot be exchanged”) and they did not attempt an alternative (e.g., proposing to bundle both exchanges upfront or advising next steps). 6) The agent respected the user’s wish to cancel the skateboard themselves and did not proceed, which is fine. Overall, failure to confirm before writes and ignoring the specified Visa preference mean the request was not completed fully in line with policy.
